text:
Ivy Morales: Small proposal: add a compact "route-insights" pill inside per-model pages showing top 3 saved queries using that model and their recent mismatch rate.
Ben Foster: That could be super helpful during model rollouts. How do we compute "mismatch rate"?
Sung Kim: Mismatch = fraction of executions where model_served != expected_primary OR effective_sampling_rate differs by > X%. Use telemetry events we already track.
metrics-bot: metrics-bot: dashboard update scheduled: model/route-mismatch-rate will be computed hourly.
Ivy Morales: UX: pill should be clickable -> opens a small flyout with the list and a one-click "open saved query". Show tiny sparklines for mismatch trend.
Ben Foster: On data retention: we'll keep these mismatch events at 90 days at full resolution then aggregate.
Sung Kim: Also flag if a saved query has >5% mismatch in last 7 days with an orange alert in the pill.
Ivy Morales: Nice. Action: Sung to own the computation, Ben to add pill in Figma, metrics-bot to schedule job.
metrics-bot: metrics-bot: job created  model/route-mismatch-rate compute
